target: AArch64 QEMU virt, one vCPU, PCI graphical terminal
verified: Graphical terminal received keyboard focus and the 40+2 smoke check returned 42.
The stock MPPrint source was included in the graphical terminal; scanout visibly contained repeated blue CPU0 callback output from its queued jobs.
The text probe uses a lower luminance threshold for the deliberate blue foreground, so it detects the visible CPU0 output.
After MPPrint completed, the terminal recovered, a second 40+2 command returned 42, and zstatus reported failed=0.
limitations: This verifies CPU0 callback and queue behavior only. It does not establish SMP execution or CPU1 worker output.
This is automated QEMU acceptance; live UTM and Raspberry Pi behavior are not established by this record.
scope_note: MPPrint runtime is accepted for the one-vCPU supported execution path. SMP worker execution remains unsupported/unverified.
